traps.description: pricing-svc is at 99% CPU, rejecting requests and pausing for GC, and a past incident blames pricing-svc CPU; but its load is 17x cart-svc's real request rate, generated by cart-svc's zero-backoff retries
The alert fires on storefront, which shipped v12.3.0 15 minutes earlier, and a past incident blames a storefront release; but storefront traffic is flat and its errors are timeouts from cart-svc
A promo-db failover at 18:20 lines up with the start, suggesting a dependency failure; but it finished in 18 s, promo-db is healthy from 18:21, and the errors last for 40 minutes
